title: Quality, Shortage and Transit-Loss Claims
summary: Settle customer claims for off-spec material, short weight and transit damage on evidence: COAs, weighbridge slips, LRs and PODs, and recover from transporters or insurers.

seo.title: Quality and Transit-Loss Claims Settlement | VipraTech
seo.description: Validate customer quality, short-weight and transit-loss claims against COAs, lab reports, weighbridge slips, LRs and PODs, and recover from carriers.

problem.intro: Chemicals, fertilisers, cement, building materials and packaged goods move in bulk by road and rail. Customers raise claims for material that is off-spec, for weight short on arrival, and for bags, drums or cartons damaged in transit. Each claim needs the certificate of analysis, the lab report, the weighbridge slips at both ends, the lorry receipt and the delivery remarks, and the loss has to be placed with the right party.

pain_points.title: Claims settled without evidence
pain_points.detail: Credit notes are raised to keep the customer happy before anyone compares the claim with the COA or the weighbridge slips.

pain_points.title: Tolerance ignored
pain_points.detail: Normal weight variation and moisture loss within the agreed tolerance are credited as shortage.

pain_points.title: Loss not recovered from the carrier
pain_points.detail: Damage noted on the POD should be recovered from the transporter or the insurer, but the claim is absorbed instead.

pain_points.title: The same loss credited twice
pain_points.detail: A shortage credited to the customer is also deducted from the transporter or claimed on insurance without anyone linking the two.

solution.overview: VipraTech reads each claim with its evidence and checks it against what was dispatched and received: the COA and any retest for quality claims, the dispatch and receipt weighbridge slips for shortage, and the LR and POD remarks for transit damage. Agreed tolerances are applied, the loss is placed with the customer, the transporter, the insurer or your plant, and the amount is recalculated. Finance gets a credit note sheet for customers and a recovery sheet for transporters and insurers, so each loss is settled once.
capabilities: Checks quality claims against the COA, specification and any retest
Checks shortage against dispatch and receipt weighbridge slips, with agreed tolerances
Checks transit damage against LR and POD remarks

match_rules.logic: A quality claim must show a parameter outside the agreed specification, compared with the COA at dispatch and any joint retest.
Shortage is the gap between dispatch and receipt weighbridge weights, less the tolerance agreed for the product and mode.
Transit damage must be noted on the POD or reported within the agreed time, with photos.
Damage noted on the POD with intact seals is a carrier loss. Off-spec material against a passing COA needs a retest before it is placed.
A loss credited to a customer is linked to any recovery from a carrier or insurer, so it is never counted twice.

exception_codes.meaning: The shortage is within the agreed tolerance.
exception_codes.action: Reject the claim, citing the tolerance.

exception_codes.meaning: The COA shows the material within specification.
exception_codes.action: Ask for a joint retest before deciding.

exception_codes.meaning: The damage was not noted at delivery.
exception_codes.action: Reject, or accept with sales sign-off.

exception_codes.meaning: The evidence places the loss with the transporter.
exception_codes.action: Credit the customer and raise a recovery.

exception_codes.meaning: The loss was settled or recovered before.
exception_codes.action: Link the earlier settlement and close.

faqs.q: Can it read our COAs and lab reports?
faqs.a: Yes. COAs, lab reports and weighbridge slips are read into structured values, and any value read with low confidence is shown to a person.

faqs.q: Different products have different tolerances. Is that a problem?
faqs.a: No. Tolerances are set by product, pack and mode of transport, from the terms in force for each customer.
It prepares the recovery sheet and evidence pack. Your team files the claim with the insurer.

faqs.q: Can it spot transporters with high losses?
faqs.a: Yes. Loss rates by lane and transporter show where losses cluster, which supports freight contract decisions.
